flota.definition:
n. A fleet; especially, a /eet of Spanish ships which formerly
   sailed every year from Cadiz to Vera Cruz, in Mexico, to transport to
   Spain the production of Spanish America.

flotage.definition:
n. The state of floating.
n. That which floats on the sea or in rivers.
flotage.translation: n. 漂浮, 浮力, 漂浮物

flotant.definition:
a. Represented as flying or streaming in the air; as, a
   banner flotant.

flotation.definition:
n. the phenomenon of floating (remaining on the surface of a liquid without sinking)
n. financing a commercial enterprise by bond or stock shares
flotation.translation:
[化] 浮; 浮游选矿
[医] 浮集(法), 浮选(法)

flotation device.translation:
浮游装备
漂浮设备
浮选设备

flotation method.translation: [医] 浮集法, 浮选法, 菲勒本氏法(检粪中虫卵)

flotations.definition:
n. the phenomenon of floating (remaining on the surface of a liquid without sinking)
n. financing a commercial enterprise by bond or stock shares
flotations.translation: n. （公开发行股票）开办新公司( flotation的复数形式 )

flotel.translation: abbr. floating hotel 流动旅馆

flotels.translation: (flotel 的第三人称 -s形式) abbr. floating hotel 流动旅馆

flotilla.definition:
n. a United States Navy fleet consisting of two or more squadrons of small warships
n. a fleet of small craft
flotilla.translation: n. 小舰队, 小型船队

flotillas.definition:
n. a United States Navy fleet consisting of two or more squadrons of small warships
n. a fleet of small craft
flotillas.translation: n. 小舰队, 小型船队( flotilla的复数形式 )

flotsam.definition: n. the floating wreckage of a ship
flotsam.translation:
n. 浮货, 废料, 零碎
[法] 漂流的船货

flotsam and jetsam.translation: 失事船只残骸, 零碎杂物, 失业者, 无固定工作者, 流浪者, 无价值物

flotsan.translation: n. 浮货, 废料, 零碎物, 流离失所者
